# RBC Quantitative Benchmark

The representative household chooses consumption and labor in each period.

Figure 1: Production function
{{FIGURE_1}}

The Euler equation is \(c_t^{-\sigma} = \beta E_t[c_{t+1}^{-\sigma} (1+r_{t+1}-\delta)]\).

| Parameter | Value |
| --- | --- |
| alpha | 0.36 |
| delta | 0.025 |

The equilibrium allocation is unique in this reduced benchmark.
